title: Study of a Candidate Gene Involved in Goldenhar Syndrome.
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to identify of the first gene involved in the Goldenhar syndrome in a cohort of 120 affected patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Spectrum of oculoauriculovertebral dysplasia minimal features include unilateral microtia and hemifacial microsomia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Absence of minimal spectrum of oculoauriculovertebral dysplasia features, molecular anomaly identified, other diagnosis
study_population: A cohort of 120 patients affected with Goldenhar/spectrum of oculoauriculovertebral dysplasia , whose phenotype is finely characterized, and that were analyzed using an oligonucleotide array-CGH pangenomic approach
